title: Microdroplet Generator Surrogate Enhancement and Inverse Design Through an Uncertainty-Guided Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.06464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Microfluidic droplet generation is critical for many applications, yet efficient device design in high-dimensional parameter spaces remains computationally prohibitive due to complex multiphase flow dynamics. This work presents a unified methodology that couples adaptive surrogate enhancement with simulation-driven inverse design. High-fidelity Volume-of-Fluid simulations provide ground-truth data, while neural network ensembles predict flow regimes and droplet diameters. Ensemble-based uncertainty quantification identifies epistemic uncertainty using consensus levels for regime classification and the coefficient of variation for diameter prediction, revealing that uncertainty concentrates near regime transition boundaries where physics is highly sensitive to parameter perturbations. translated_title: 基于不确定性引导框架的微液滴生成器代理模型增强与逆向设计
translated_abstract: 微流控液滴生成对许多应用至关重要，然而由于复杂的多相流动力学，在高维参数空间中进行高效的器件设计在计算上仍然代价高昂。本工作提出了一种统一的方法论，将自适应代理模型增强与仿真驱动的逆向设计相结合。高保真度的流体体积法模拟提供真实基准数据，神经网络集成模型则预测流型状态和液滴直径。基于集成模型的不确定性量化利用一致性水平（用于流型分类）和变异系数（用于直径预测）来识别认知不确定性，发现不确定性集中在流型转变边界附近——在这些区域，物理特性对参数扰动高度敏感。一种物理驱动的数据增强策略针对这些关键区域，通过部署额外的针对性模拟并重新训练模型来应对类别不平衡问题。
tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性引导框架，利用神经网络集成的不确定性量化定位流型转变边界等关键区域，并通过物理驱动的针对性模拟数据增强策略提升代理模型精度，从而实现微液滴生成器的高效逆向设计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-guided framework that leverages ensemble-based uncertainty quantification to identify critical regions near flow regime transition boundaries, and employs a physics-informed targeted simulation enrichment strategy to enhance surrogate models for efficient inverse design of microdroplet generators.
